en.title: Minimum Insertions to Form a Repeated abc String
en.description:
Given a non-empty string containing only a, b and c, you may insert characters at any position. Find the minimum number of insertions needed to turn it into a concatenation of one or more abc strings.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
hints: Whenever adjacent characters are not strictly increasing, a new abc block must start; multiply the number of blocks by 3 and subtract the original length.
